Inspect the installed Home Assistant version and existing integration approach. Prefer an official local integration. Define entities, units, device classes, availability/freshness and connection ownership. If YAML or code is requested, produce complete configuration with validation, logs, test steps and rollback. Begin read-only. Do not invent entity IDs or services; list required placeholders explicitly.
